text:
Alex M: heading into the night shift — want to run a quick access + coverage sanity check before I hand off to Priya. primary/secondary for tonight? :coffee:
Priya K: I'm primary 00:00-08:00 PT, Jamal is secondary. I'll be covering EU morning overlap at 07:00 PT.
Jamal R: secondary here. also will be available for APAC morning if pages come through early.
Alex M: sweet. specific checklist I'm running through: PagerDuty escalation, AWS console/assume-role, Grafana dashboard access, runbook links.
Marta L: quick note — we had a permission drift last week where the Grafana service account lost viewer perms. confirmed with infra that role arn:arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallGrafana still maps.
SRE Bot: incident-bot: new incident created #3242 - latency spike on embedder cluster. pages sent to pd:team-inference (primary: Priya K).
Priya K: saw the bot. I'll take the page if it fires. can someone reconfirm PD escalation policy is intact? last change was two weeks ago.
Alex M: PD check: run `pd escalation-policy get team-inference` or open https://pagerduty.com/orgs/redwood-ops/escalation_policies/team-inference — policy shows primary->secondary->oncall-manager.
Jamal R: AWS: please make sure you can `aws sso login --profile oncall-prod` and then `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Oncall` for console. I usually step through:
```
aws sso login --profile oncall-prod
aws sts get-caller-identity --profile oncall-prod
```
Alex M: Grafana: use SSO (Okta). Dashboards: `ops/latency`, `ops/embedding-availability`, and `infra/gpu-util`. Bookmark them. If you get a 403, the common fix is to re-sync group in Okta or ask infra to run `./scripts/sync-grafana-groups.sh`.
Priya K: runbook quick links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall (main index), https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embedder-latency (embedder playbook). I'll paste the short play steps for embedder latency below for quick access:
```
1) Check autoscale group (ASG) health in AWS console
2) Check inference pods for OOMs: `kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide`
3) Check redis/kv cache hit rates in Grafana
4) If pod restarts >3 in 5m, run rollback to last stable model variant
5) If continuing, escalate to infra oncall (page infra-oncall)
```
Marta L: Access note: if anyone needs console-level keys, we do NOT store long-lived IAM keys for oncall. Use SSO/assume-role or ephemeral sessions. If you need admin elevation, open a request to `#eng-infra` with justification and 2FA.
Jamal R: coverage gap: APAC early morning (00:00-04:00 UTC) can be thin if both EU and US wake windows misalign. Priya, can you confirm you can cover 07:00 PT to 09:00 PT overlap with EU?
Priya K: yes I can extend to 09:00 PT today. if anything critical pops I'll escalate to infra and wake ops-manager.
Alex M: final quick perms checklist before I drop:
- PagerDuty: can you trigger a test page? (Priya)
- AWS: can you run `aws sts get-caller-identity`? (Priya/Jamal)
- Grafana: open ops/latency and confirm no 403. (Priya)
- Runbook: confirm you can access both links. (Priya)
Priya K: done: test PD page received ✅, `aws sts get-caller-identity` returned expected account ✅, Grafana dashboards load ✅, runbooks open ✅.
Alex M: perfect. leaving a sticky in the channel: if you get the embedder latency page, follow runbook and annotate PD incident with `mitigation=scale-up` or `mitigation=rollback` as appropriate. Also add any customer-visible impact lines to the incident notes (customers affected, percent requests impacted, estimated time window).
Marta L: couple of last bits — if you're paged and need to hand off mid-incident, use `!handoff` in PD to record who takes ownership, and post a one-line update in this thread so we have the timeline.
SRE Bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance tonight 02:30 UTC on infra-gpu-1 (non-disruptive), will run canary only.
Alex M: thanks all — passing primary to Priya now. I'll be reachable for 30m by DM. GL HF :thumbsup:
